description: Give a member a role. Preflights the bot's role hierarchy so the failure mode is an explanation, not a 403. Supports dry_run. A role that would give the member moderator or admin powers (such as banning, kicking, or timing out members, deleting other people's messages, or managing the server, roles, or channels), or let them see channels hidden from them now, needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. Other roles are given at once.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

name: assign_role
title: Assign role
